def test_path(self):
    self.proc = subprocess.Popen(PYTHON, stdout=DEVNULL, stderr=DEVNULL)
    time.sleep(0.1)  # XXX: provisional, fix needed
    self.assertEqual(psutil.Process(self.proc.pid).path, os.path.dirname(PYTHON))
